description: Synthetic: Claude Code's AskUserQuestion picker in a narrow pane. Its question ends mid-row of a wrapped │-barred paragraph, so no cursor walk can ground it as a row; every option, the ❯ highlighted one included, is drawn behind the digit that commits it in one key. The card must be the menu (a digit answers any row), not a cursor list the phone cannot walk. The ⟪dim⟫ markers sit where the capture puts them.
